rules.title: Rules
rules.boardText: Each player has 9 pits (uya) and a kazan for captured korgools. Every pit starts with 9 korgools, 162 in total.
rules.sowText: Take every korgool from one of your pits and sow them one by one counter-clockwise, starting with the same pit. A single korgool moves to the next pit.
rules.sowCaption: Four korgools from pit 7: into pits 7, 8, 9 and the opponent's pit 1.
rules.captureText: If your last korgool lands on the opponent's side and makes an even number, every korgool in that pit goes to your kazan.
rules.captureCaption: The opponent's pit 2 now holds 6 — all six go to your kazan.
rules.tuzdykText: If your last korgool makes exactly 3 in an opponent's pit, it becomes your tuzdyk for good: everything that lands there is yours. One tuzdyk per game; never in pit 9, and not in the pit with the same number as the opponent's tuzdyk.
rules.tuzdykCaption: The opponent's pit 1 is now your tuzdyk.
rules.winText: The first to collect 82 korgools wins. 81 : 81 is a draw. If a player cannot move, the opponent collects the korgools left on their own side.
